# Artifacts and facts are prunable while provenance survives pruning

Artifacts.content and FactRow rows are described as staging/prunable, whereas provenance rows are denormalized and explicitly survive fact pruning.

Allow removal of large or transient staged data while retaining provenance snapshots for historical traceability.
